$comment: The `board` binding is an InferOpsProjectSession from the inferops gatekeeper (custom-gatekeepers/gatekeeper-inferops). blueprintId is the install key: never rename it.
title: InferOps Kanban
description: Use to view an InferOps project board as Kanban columns and move issues between workflow states, with every move approved before it reaches InferOps. Needs one InferOps project board connected as the `board` binding.

board.title: InferOps project board
board.description: The InferOps project whose board this gadget shows, e.g. inferops://demo.local/project/board/DEMO.
